dedup_standard: Two ideas are hard duplicates when they assert the same core scientific claim such that decisively falsifying/verifying one substantially falsifies/verifies the other; a domain re-instantiation counts as distinct only if the domain changes the mechanism or the prediction, not merely the dataset. Entailment, nested claims, and competing mechanisms over one observable are NOT duplicates — they are flagged.

competing_pairs.why_protect: Everything-mode count ceiling: grid/NMS sampling machinery vs learned SA-1B count prior. A-086 is explicitly designed as a residual test beyond A-040's mechanical model.

Where label conventions live: A-017 says decoder-only adaptation cannot absorb convention shifts; A-046 says a retrained decoder ports conventions across domains. Matched contradiction defining a decisive experiment.
Low LoRA rank: an unnecessary restriction once spectral regularization is added (A-019) vs a beneficial label-noise filter on dirty data (A-053).
Training order: anti-curriculum by zero-shot difficulty (A-057) vs curriculum by rater agreement (B-097). Opposite-signed predictions across territories.
Ensemble disagreement maps irreducible rater ambiguity (B-059) vs correctable label error (B-077). Competing interpretations of one signal; must not be merged into a single vague claim.
What prompt-jitter variance measures: epistemic model uncertainty decoupled from ambiguity (A-066) vs a stimulus-ambiguity meter for boundary-undefined objects (C-034).
Click-refinement oscillation cause: decoder correction-memory deficit predicting oscillation on complex solids too (A-005) vs boundary-undefinedness predicting monotone convergence on solids (C-036).
In-camera flicker aliasing: a confound that invalidates flicker features across sensors (C-052) vs a signal that discriminates flame within single frames (C-063).

High-frequency content for smoke: dispensable distractor texture such that downsampling helps (C-085) vs essential evidence destroyed by compression (C-067). Both can hold at different operating points — mapping the crossover is the experiment.
Boundary label noise: globally corrosive on solids (A-027) vs nearly harmless on media (C-093). Cross-territory contradiction that doubles as a probe of what boundary supervision teaches.

singular_anomalies.why_protect: Untrained humans beat models on incipient smoke via pre-attentive motion pop-out. Psychophysics claim; superficially a 'temporal family' member but not a model variant — do not sweep into F25 merges.
Abstention preferentially rejects pathological cases (care-disparity engine). Safety/equity claim distinct from the calibration family; easy to mistake for generic selective-prediction critique.
Intermediate-accuracy automation yields better final corrected contours than best models (vigilance mechanism). Counterintuitive human-factors claim, not a model-quality claim.
Random-encoder LoRA control: quantifies the any-features-plus-training share of 'foundation model adaptation'. Reads like a baseline nitpick; it is the missing control for the entire T01 literature.
Two-polarization capture may make transparency nearly trivial — reframes an 'algorithmic frontier' as an RGB-sensor artifact. Field-level reframing worth protecting.
Linear re-basing of LoRAs across base-model generations. Only lifecycle-portability claim in the batch; superficially similar to merging/arithmetic ideas (A-022) but orthogonal.
Fire ground truth is exposure-defined (GT is a function of the sensor). Labels-side claim distinct from model glare-tracing (C-071); anchors family F26.
Detecting surgical absence is a distinct capability that presence-trained models cannot learn from ordinary data. Contains a learnability claim beyond the hallucination family.

Test-time self-consistency adaptation: prompt/augmentation disagreement used as a training signal on one image. Superficially in the jitter family (F04) but is an adaptation method claim, not a measurement claim.
Segmenters respond identically to real and diffusion-generated smoke — a spoofing/false-alarm channel. Only security-flavored claim in the batch.

SA-1B privacy-blur shortcut (blur boundaries attract masks). Provenance-specific defect; gen_A already flagged its [VERIFIED PRIOR WORK] tag for downstream fact-check — protect the idea, verify the premise.
Direct image-to-measurement regression beats segment-then-measure. Questions segmentation as a universal intermediate; no sibling in any shard.
